record.field: purpose: show the latest lines of the Odoo server log on a minion when: first step for Odoo-related drift alerts — see what happened right before when not: to search for error patterns (use grep_odoo_errors); to change anything example: {"minion": "sparv", "lines": 100} output: the latest N lines from the log file per minion guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"Minion ID where Odoo runs"},"lines":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of lines to show","default":100},"log_path":{"type":"string","description":"Path to the Odoo log","default":"/var/log/odoo/odoo.log"}},"required":["minion"]}

async def execute(minion, lines=100, log_path="/var/log/odoo/odoo.log"): """Tail the Odoo server log on a minion.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"tail -n {int(lines)} {log_path}")

purpose: search ERROR/CRITICAL lines (or a custom pattern) in the Odoo log on a minion when: after tail_odoo_log, when looking for error patterns and tracebacks in the log when not: to see recent events (use tail_odoo_log); to change anything example: {"minion": "sparv", "pattern": "ERROR|CRITICAL", "lines": 100} output: matching log lines per minion (latest N) guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"Minion ID where Odoo runs"},"pattern":{"type":"string","description":"Grep pattern (EGREP)","default":"ERROR|CRITICAL"},"lines":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of matches to show","default":100},"log_path":{"type":"string","description":"Path to the Odoo log","default":"/var/log/odoo/odoo.log"}},"required":["minion"]}

async def execute(minion, pattern="ERROR|CRITICAL", lines=100, log_path="/var/log/odoo/odoo.log"): """Grep for errors in the Odoo log on a minion.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"grep -aE '{pattern}' {log_path} | tail -n {int(lines)}")

purpose: list cron jobs in the Odoo instance where the coworker runs when: Odoo-related drift alerts may be caused by cron jobs not running (e.g. missing indexing) when not: to change cron jobs (read-only); to inspect other Odoo instances (use salt_cmd_run + psql) example: {"limit": 50} output: list with name, active, nextcall, model, method per cron guardrail: read-only operation, safe

async def execute(limit=50): """List cron jobs in this Odoo instance.""" crons = env['ir.cron'].sudo().search_read( [], ['name', 'active', 'nextcall', 'model', 'method'], limit=int(limit), order='nextcall') return json.dumps(crons, indent=2, default=str)

async def execute(): """Verify Odoo status (this instance).""" return json.dumps({ 'uid': env.uid, 'user': env.user.name, 'db': env.cr.dbname, 'base_url': env['ir.config_parameter'].sudo().get_param('web.base.url', ''), }, indent=2)

purpose: search records in an Odoo model (this instance) — verify that models/data respond when: to confirm that Odoo data is available during diagnosis when not: to read specific fields (use odoo_read); to count (use odoo_count) example: {"model": "res.partner", "domain": "[['is_company','=',True]]", "limit": 10} output: list of record IDs matching the domain guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"string","description":"Odoo model (e.g. res.partner, salt.minion)"},"domain":{"type":"string","description":"Domain as JSON string","default":"[]"},"limit":{"type":"integer","description":"Max number of hits","default":50}},"required":["model"]}

purpose: read specific fields from records in an Odoo model (this instance) when: after odoo_search, to inspect field values on the found records when not: to search records (use odoo_search); to change data (read-only) example: {"model": "salt.minion", "ids": "[1,2,3]", "fields": "['name','ip','is_online']"} output: field values per record guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"model":{"type":"string","description":"Odoo model"},"ids":{"type":"string","description":"Record IDs as JSON list","default":"[]"},"fields":{"type":"string","description":"Fields to read as JSON list (empty = all)","default":"[]"}},"required":["model"]}

purpose: count records matching a domain in an Odoo model (this instance) when: to quickly quantify data (e.g. number of active minions, number of alerts) when not: to fetch the records themselves (use odoo_search) example: {"model": "salt.minion", "domain": "[['is_online','=',True]]"} output: number of hits guardrail: read-only operation, safe

purpose: check that PostgreSQL responds on a minion (pg_isready) when: first step for database-related drift alerts — is PG up? when not: for detailed query status (use pg_stat_activity); to change anything example: {"minion": "pg-1", "host": "localhost", "port": "5432"} output: pg_isready output (accepting connections / no response) guardrail: read-only operation, safe

async def execute(minion, host="localhost", port="5432"): """Check that PostgreSQL responds.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"pg_isready -h {host} -p {port}")

purpose: show active queries/connections in PostgreSQL on a minion (pg_stat_activity) when: for performance issues, connection leaks or locked queries when not: to check whether PG responds (use pg_isready); to change anything example: {"minion": "pg-1", "host": "localhost", "port": "5432", "user": "postgres", "db": "postgres"} output: pid, usename, state, wait_event_type, query_start and the first 80 chars of query guardrail: read-only operation, safe

async def execute(minion, host="localhost", port="5432", user="postgres", db="postgres"): """Show active PG queries.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] sql = ("SELECT pid, usename, state, wait_event_type, query_start, " "left(query,80) AS q FROM pg_stat_activity " "ORDER BY query_start DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20") return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"psql -h {host} -p {port} -U {user} -d {db} -x -c \"{sql}\"")

purpose: show streaming replication status and lag (pg_stat_replication) on the primary when: for HA questions — is the standby in sync? how big is the lag? when not: to check whether PG responds (use pg_isready); to change anything example: {"minion": "pg-1", "host": "localhost", "port": "5432", "user": "postgres", "db": "postgres"} output: client_addr, state and lag_bytes per standby guardrail: read-only operation, safe

async def execute(minion, host="localhost", port="5432", user="postgres", db="postgres"): """Show replication lag.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] sql = ("SELECT client_addr, state, " "pg_wal_lsn_diff(pg_current_wal_lsn(), replay_lsn) AS lag_bytes " "FROM pg_stat_replication") return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", f"psql -h {host} -p {port} -U {user} -d {db} -x -c \"{sql}\"")

purpose: check whether the Caddy service is running on a minion when: first step for 502/504 or proxy-related drift alerts when not: to see errors (use caddy_recent_errors); to restart (use salt_service_restart) example: {"minion": "gw0"} output: true/false + active status from systemd guardrail: read-only operation, safe
async def execute(minion): """Check Caddy service status.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] return api.salt_call("local", minion, "service.status", "caddy")

purpose: show recent error/panic lines from the Caddy journal on a minion when: after caddy_status, to understand WHY the proxy returns 502/504 when not: to see the whole journal (use salt_journal_errors); to change anything example: {"minion": "gw0", "lines": 100} output: matching journalctl lines (error/fail/panic) guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"Minion ID where Caddy runs"},"lines":{"type":"integer","description":"Number of journal lines to search","default":100}},"required":["minion"]}

async def execute(minion, lines=100): """Show recent Caddy errors from the journal.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] cmd = f"journalctl -u caddy -n {int(lines)} --no-pager | grep -iE 'error|fail|panic' || true" return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", cmd)

purpose: check the health of an upstream behind Caddy (HTTP status + response time) on a minion when: on 502/504 — is the backend up? does it respond fast? when not: to check the Caddy service itself (use caddy_status); to change anything example: {"minion": "gw0", "url": "http://localhost:8069"} output: "HTTP <code> — <response_time>s" or a curl error guardrail: read-only operation, safe

{"type":"object","properties":{"minion":{"type":"string","description":"Minion ID where Caddy runs"},"url":{"type":"string","description":"Upstream URL to test (e.g. http://localhost:8069)"}},"required":["minion","url"]}

async def execute(minion, url): """Check upstream health.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] cmd = f"curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{{http_code}} - %{{time_total}}s\\n' --max-time 15 '{url}' || echo 'curl error (upstream down?)'" return api.salt_call("local", minion, "cmd.run", cmd)

purpose: list Wazuh agents and their status (active/disconnected/never_connected) when: on security alerts — is the agent for the host connected? when not: to fetch alerts (use wazuh_recent_alerts); to change anything example: {"limit": 100} output: agent list with id, name, ip and status guardrail: read-only operation, safe
async def execute(limit=100): """List Wazuh agent status.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] return api.wazuh_call("agents", {"limit": int(limit)})

purpose: fetch the latest security alerts from the Wazuh Manager when: to correlate a drift alert with security events on the same host when not: to check agent status (use wazuh_agent_status); to change anything example: {"limit": 20} output: latest alerts (rule, level, agent, timestamp, description) guardrail: read-only operation, safe
async def execute(limit=20): """Fetch the latest Wazuh alerts.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] return api.wazuh_call("alerts", {"limit": int(limit), "sort": "-timestamp"})

purpose: list known vulnerabilities (CVE) from the Wazuh inventory when: when a security alert may be linked to a known CVE on a host when not: to fetch alerts (use wazuh_recent_alerts); to change anything example: {"limit": 20} output: CVE list (cve, package, severity, agent) guardrail: read-only operation, safe
async def execute(limit=20): """Fetch the CVE list from Wazuh.""" api = env['saltstack.ai.config'] return api.wazuh_call("cve", {"limit": int(limit)})

purpose: domain-specific diagnostics — Odoo logs/RPC, PostgreSQL, Caddy and Wazuh/SIEM when: any work beyond the generic salt/zabbix tools — log interpretation, database, proxy, security when not: for generic SaltStack operations (use the salt capability); for generic Zabbix monitoring (use the zabbix capability) example: {"operation": "tail_odoo_log", "minion": "sparv"} → {"operation": "grep_odoo_errors", "minion": "sparv"} → {"operation": "pg_stat_activity", "minion": "pg-1"} output: per operation — see each operation's description guardrail: all diagnostics operations are read_only; actions are done with the salt capability's destructive tools (require approval)
